identity.title: GW Ori: Interactions between a Triple-star System and Its Circumtriple Disk in Action

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) observations of 1.3 mm dust continuum and ^12^CO $J=2-1$ molecular gas emission of the disk.

evidence.quote: GW Ori is a hierarchical triple system (cite: berger2011) at a distance of 402 $\pm$ 10 parsec (cite: gaia2018).
GW Ori is a hierarchical triple system (cite: berger2011) at a distance of 402 $\pm$ 10 parsec (cite: gaia2018).

question.value: What substructures (rings, eccentricity, misalignment) does the circumtriple disk of GW Ori have, and do they indicate ongoing interactions with the triple stars?

evidence.quote: where we find new substructures of the disk that indicate ongoing disk-star interactions.
The observations were taken on December 10, 2017 (ID: 2017.1.00286.S).
The disk was observed in Band 6 (1.3 mm) by 46 antennas, with baseline lengths ranging from 15 to 3321 meters.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: Continuum basebands 1.875 GHz wide at 217 and 233 GHz; three line basebands of 117 MHz, 112 kHz resolution at 230.518, 219.541, 220.380 GHz

evidence.quote: There were two 1.875-GHz-wide basebands centered at 217 and 233 GHz for continuum emission, and three basebands with 117 MHz bandwidths and 112 kHz resolution
centered at 230.518, 219.541 and 220.380 GHz to cover the ^12^CO, ^13^CO and C^18^O $J=2-1$ lines.
The disk was observed in Band 6 (1.3 mm) by 46 antennas, with baseline lengths ranging from 15 to 3321 meters.
Figure [\[fig:obs\]](#fig:obs)a shows the continuum map with spatial resolution of 0".098 ($\sim$ 39 AU).
The total on source integration time was 1.6 hours.
The observations were taken on December 10, 2017 (ID: 2017.1.00286.S).

what.value: Stellar masses ~2.7, 1.7, 0.9 Msun and AB-C orbit inclination/node

evidence.quote: The stellar masses have been constrained to be $\sim$ 2.7, 1.7, and 0.9 $M_\odot$, respectively (cite: czekala2017).
The stellar luminosity modified by the distance provided by GAIA DR2 is 49.3 $\pm$ 7.4 $L_{\odot}$ (cite: calvet2004; gaia2018).

what.value: Dust opacity 10 cm2/g at 1000 GHz, index 1

evidence.quote: We assume a dust grain opacity of 10 cm^2^ g^-1^ at 1000 GHz with a power-law index of 1 (cite: beckwith1990).

simulations_or_models_as_data.value: DALI 12CO channel-map models of a misaligned disk, and a PHANTOM SPH simulation of the disk around the binary

evidence.quote: The ^12^CO channel maps are then computed and ray-traced by the physical-chemical modeling code DALI (cite: bruderer2013)
The data were calibrated by the pipeline calibration script provided by ALMA.
We performed phase self-calibration onto the image with a solution interval of 20 seconds.
We adopted CASA task CLEAN to image the continuum map
in the BRIGGS weighting scheme with robust = 0.5, and velocity resolution 0.5 km s^-1^.
(after subtracting the continuum on the self-calibrated data)

final_beam.value: continuum 0.098" circular; CO 0.122" x 0.159", PA -32.3 deg

evidence.quote: The resulting line cube has a beam size of 0".122 $\times$ 0".159 at the position angle -32.3^$\circ$^.

final_rms.value: continuum ~40 uJy/beam; CO ~1.4 mJy/beam per channel

evidence.quote: The noise level is $\sim$ 1.4 mJy beam^-1^ per channel and the peak signal-to-noise ratio is $\sim$ 83.

what.value: Gas surface density and aspect-ratio prescription and parameters for CO modelling

evidence.quote: Following the prescription and parameter values used to fit low resolution CO isotopologue data of GW Ori (cite: fang2017)
Similar to (cite: walsh2017), we model the misaligned disk with an inner cavity and three annuli

unstated_but_needed: CLEAN threshold, mask, cell and image size, number of iterations
Self-calibration reference model and how many rounds
MCMC priors' numeric bounds, initial walker positions, and convergence checks
DALI chemistry and model setup details beyond Table 4

method.value: Pipeline calibration, phase self-cal, CASA CLEAN with uniform weighting (continuum) and Briggs robust 0.5 (CO)

evidence.quote: We adopted CASA task CLEAN to image the continuum map (Figure [\[fig:obs\]](#fig:obs)a), with the UNIFORM weighting scheme and a 0".098 circular restoring beam.

validation.value: Flux consistent with previous ALMA observations

evidence.quote: The integrated flux density of the disk (195 $\pm$ 20 mJy) is consistent with the result from previous ALMA observations (cite: czekala2017).

method.value: Optically thin dust mass equation with ring-radius dependent dust temperature

evidence.quote: We estimate the dust (solid) mass $M_{\text{dust}}$ of the rings with the equation provided in (cite: hildebrand1983)

assumptions.value: T_dust = 30 (L/38 Lsun)^1/4 (r/100 AU)^-1/2; kappa 10 cm2/g at 1000 GHz, index 1; d=402 pc

evidence.quote: We assume a dust grain opacity of 10 cm^2^ g^-1^ at 1000 GHz with a power-law index of 1 (cite: beckwith1990).

method.value: Three Gaussian-profile rings fitted in visibilities; Model 1 independent inclined circular rings; Models 2/3 eccentric inner ring

evidence.quote: We fit the dust continuum map assuming that there are three dust rings in the disk with Gaussian radial profiles of surface brightness
For each model, there are 144 chains spread in the hyperspace of parameters. Each chain has 15000 iterations including 10000 burn-in iterations.

fitting.value: emcee MCMC, Gaussian likelihood on real and imaginary visibilities with weights; flat bounds priors

evidence.quote: The prior function is set to guarantee the surface brightness, ring radius, and ring width do not go below zero

validation.value: Residual map from visibility subtraction; uv-plot and posteriors shown

evidence.quote: The residual map is produced by subtracting model from data in the visibility plane, and then imaging the results in the same way used for the observations.

method.value: DALI models with three annuli of different inclination/PA, run through ALMA simulator, compared with first-moment map against coplanar model by eye

evidence.quote: The channel map is run through the ALMA simulator using the settings of the ALMA observations.

key_parameters.value: disk mass 0.12 Msun, Sigma_c=3 g/cm2, rc=320 AU, gamma=1.0, (h/r)c=0.18, psi=0.1, gas-to-dust 100

evidence.quote: with $\gamma$ = 1.0, $(h/r)_c$ = 0.18 and $\psi$ = 0.1.
the manual fitting of gas model cannot provide any uncertainties for the gap between the inner and middle ring
The models show that the ^12^CO $J=2-1$ first-moment map in the ALMA observation cannot be reproduced by a coplanar disk.

method.value: Analytic radial communication, precession and alignment timescales; PHANTOM SPH simulation with 10^6 particles

evidence.quote: We carry out a demonstrative smoothed particle hydrodynamic (SPH) simulation with the PHANTOM code

key_parameters.value: alpha_AV=0.31, h/r=0.05, disk mass 0.1 Msun, 40-400 AU

evidence.quote: We take a locally isothermal disk with a constant aspect ratio $h/r=0.05$
We used the Common Astronomy Software Applications package (cite: mcmullin2007) to process the data.
we calculate the synthetic visibility of the models using GALARIO (cite: tazzari2018)
launch MCMC parameter surveys to derive posterior distribution of model parameters using EMCEE (cite: dfm2013)
ray-traced by the physical-chemical modeling code DALI (cite: bruderer2013)
with the PHANTOM code (cite: lodato2010; price2010; price2018)
We identify three dust rings with different apparent shapes in the disk at $\sim$ 46, 188, and 338 AU
We estimate the dust masses of the rings to be 74 $\pm$ 8, 168 $\pm$ 19, and 245 $\pm$ 28 $M_\oplus$, respectively
The continuum flux densities of the inner, middle, and outer ring are 42 $\pm$ 4, 95 $\pm$ 10 and 58 $\pm$ 6 mJy, respectively.
The integrated flux density of the disk (195 $\pm$ 20 mJy)
are 11 $\pm$ 6, $\sim$28[^2], 35 $\pm$ 5, and 40 $\pm$ 5 degrees, respectively.

results_numeric.quantity: Global precession and radial communication timescales

evidence.quote: the global precession time-scale of the entire disk is $\sim$ 0.83 Myr, and the radial communication time-scale is $\sim$ 0.06 Myr

findings_qualitative.value: Outermost ring is the largest dust ring found in a protoplanetary disk; CO first-moment map shows a twisted pattern inside ~0.2" suggesting misalignment.

evidence.quote: we find a twisted pattern inside $\sim$ 0".2, which may result from a misalignment between the inner and outer parts of the disk

claims.experiment: MCMC visibility modelling with three models
claims.result: Different centers and inclinations; inner ring e~0.19-0.21
claims.finding: Inner ring is eccentric and rings are mutually misaligned

evidence.quote: the inner ring has an eccentricity of $\sim$ 0.2, and the three rings have statistically different on-sky projected inclinations

claims.experiment: DALI misaligned vs coplanar first-moment maps

evidence.quote: the misaligned disk model described in Table [4](#tab:gas) matches the observed first-moment map better

claims.hypothesis: Triple star torque alone explains inner/middle misalignment
claims.finding: Another mechanism (e.g. companion) needed to break the disk

evidence.quote: the torque from the GW Ori triple stars alone cannot explain the observed large misalignment between the inner and middle dust rings

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Coplanar disk (i=37.9, PA=-5) rejected for CO kinematics; viscous-regime breaking disfavoured by low observed alpha

evidence.quote: in which the disk is coplanar with an inclination of 37.9^$\circ$^ and a position angle of -5^$\circ$^.

limitations_admitted.value: Mutual inclinations cannot be determined from dust alone due to unknown orbital direction; gas model has no uncertainties for the gap.

evidence.quote: we cannot determine the mutual inclinations between them (i.e., the angles between their angular momentum vectors) from dust emission modelling alone

referee_caveats_inferred: Dust masses depend on assumed opacity and temperature law and optically thin assumption
Gas model fit is manual with no quantitative goodness of fit

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: ~100-300 GB raw for one long-baseline Band 6 execution
reproducibility.score_reason: Single public dataset and a clear model structure, but imaging parameters and fitting details are incomplete.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric ring radii, masses and ring-fit parameters can be reproduced with moderate assumptions.

companion_papers.why: Low-resolution CO modelling and disk structure
